headline: Waist-high SSE windswell, clean early then onshore — a dawn log session.
today: Short-period stuff at 2ft and change, fair angle, but the morning's the play: dawn cross-off and a light SSW behind it keep it glassy through the early low. Ride the log or a groveler and get it before the SSE onshore fills in around midday. Afternoon goes soft and bumpy, not worth it.

daysToWatch.note: Prime SE angle at 6-8s but only knee-high — dawn cross-off is clean if you just want to slide the log. Onshore ramps up hard by afternoon.
That prime SE angle and a 3.6ft total wave, but 15-19mph S onshore all day torches it. Blown out — skip.
Biggest of the week at pushing 3ft, though short-period and mushy. Light morning wind gives a clean-ish window before the SSE onshore builds.
